compatibility.note: Derived from every real node sequence in templates/templates.json (incl. per-route sequences).

subpageUsage: Same VideoSection component as the homepage, configured by props (no explicit `variant` prop). Subpage instances drop the homepage's trailing LLM paragraph (footnote={null} everywhere), use a single-line body or none (body={null} on /pricing), may put an italic emphasis word in the H2 (with a forced line break on /lms/mentoring-software) and use per-page padding / video margins / a 4:3 video on /pricing. Structure: centred H2, optional grey line, then a full-width (45.25rem max on /lms/mentoring-software) rounded video placeholder with a 36px play button; no embed. Used on the six /lms/features/* routes that define d.video (lms-homepage, spaces, chat, ai-content-creator, mcp, mobile-lms), /nova and /lms/mentoring-software; on /pricing it is rendered as a child inside ReviewsGrid (modelled by that section, not here).
evidenceNotes: footnote={null} on every subpage usage (FeatureDetail.jsx, Nova.jsx, MentoringSoftware.jsx, Pricing.jsx); only the homepage renders the LLM paragraph.

/pricing nests <VideoSection body={null} videoLabel="Video 4:3" .../> as children of <ReviewsGrid> (src/pages/platform/Pricing.jsx); another section contract models that composite. Its heading ('You are not buying just a platform', 7 words) is included in this branch's budget so the nested instance also validates.

Feature routes without d.video (learning-pathways, lms-analytics, skills, employee-assessment-software, lms-admin, lms-rewards, lms-security, employee-experience, communication, employee-performance-management-software, lms-gamification) render no VideoSection.

pages-manifest.json's page-nova template lists neither a video nor a faq section, yet Nova.jsx renders VideoSection ('See Nova at work') and Faq. For /pricing the manifest only has 'reviews-grid' (the VideoSection is nested inside it in code).
